items.question: Which further embodied feminine forms partake in devotional knowledge on earth?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate beings who know through devotion on earth.
Ulukī and pecakī are included among such knowing beings.
Sararī and gūlī are likewise presented as alternatives sharing this knowledge.
items.inference: Additional embodied feminine forms, named as ulukī, pecakī, sararī, and gūlī, also partake in the same devotional knowledge.
uncertainties: The precise identities or symbolic referents of sararī and gūlī are unclear in this context.
items.plain_english: The owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sararī-woman, or the gūlī-woman likewise know in this way.
